---
title: "Teaching"
---

I have been involved in teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels since 2017, first at the University of Tübingen and then at the University of Basel. My teaching spans field courses, lab practicals, statistics, and student mentoring.

---

## University of Basel

**Teaching assistant** · 2022 – present

- **Blockkurs Ecology and Nature Conservation** — intensive field and lab course for biology students
- **Invasive Species excursion** — identification and ecology of invasive plants in the field
- **Medicinal and Poisonous Plants excursion** — applied botanical identification
- **Methods in Ecology** — introduction to ecological research methods and study design

---

## University of Tübingen

**Teaching assistant** · 2017 – 2022

- **Advanced Biometry** — statistical methods for biologists; mixed models, experimental design
- **Fundamentals of Coding** — introduction to R and reproducible data analysis for biology students
- **Botany** — lab course and field excursions; plant identification, morphology, anatomy
- **Pharmaceutical Biology** — herbarium examination, essay evaluation, botanical excursions for pharmacy students
- **First-Year Student Mentoring** — contact person and advisor for incoming biology students

**Research assistant** · 2017 – 2022

- Vegetation Ecology Group — field and lab work across multiple projects
- Plant Evolutionary Ecology Group — research support
- Behavioral Ecology — preparation of experimental materials

---

## Plant identification

In 2021 I passed the SW400–Berberis examination at the University of Tübingen, which certifies knowledge of 400 plant species and their families, plus the 25 most common plant families in southwest Germany.
